# rule-set-loads: a list sing-box loads fills the firewall sets; one without addresses is not read; one not loaded again is not read again

instance 1 Start -> ok
engine Ready -> ok

== sing-box loads the list /subnets.lst: 11.0.0.0/24 11.0.2.0/24
